Files: utilization.csv (per-instance p95 CPU and memory utilization) and instance_catalog.csv (instance types with vcpu, memory_gib, hourly_usd). Rightsizing rule: for each instance, required_vcpu = current_vcpu * p95_cpu_pct/100 / 0.7 and required_mem = current_memory_gib * p95_mem_pct/100 / 0.8. The recommended type is the cheapest instance_type in the SAME family (from instance_catalog.csv) with vcpu >= required_vcpu and memory_gib >= required_mem. If no type in the family satisfies both, keep the current type. Monthly cost = hourly_usd * 730. What is the recommended instance_type for instance i-a272bb8eabd6?

Data files in your working directory: utilization.csv, instance_catalog.csv.

Required final answer format (JSON inside <answer></answer> tags):
{"instance_type": "<type>"}

tool_calls.name: run_python
tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd
u = pd.read_csv('utilization.csv')
c = pd.read_csv('instance_catalog.csv')
row = u[u.instance_id=='i-a272bb8eabd6'].iloc[0]
cur = c[c.instance_type==row.instance_type].iloc[0]
req_vcpu = cur.vcpu * row.p95_cpu_pct/100 / 0.7
req_mem = cur.memory_gib * row.p95_mem_pct/100 / 0.8
print(cur, req_vcpu, req_mem)
fam = c[c.family==cur.family]
cand = fam[(fam.vcpu>=req_vcpu)&(fam.memory_gib>=req_mem)].sort_values('hourly_usd')
print(cand)
